findings.title: Advertising-specific recalculation, SLO and declared-capacity evidence are incomplete
findings.engineeringReason: targeted queue、expiry/maturity 与 hourly repair 覆盖 purpose proof、历史 Metric verification 和物理窗口失效。48 independent action-purpose Profile 的解析合并成一个数据库 snapshot，不使用跨任务 cache 或默认值；40 历史动作 preparation clock 只在 synthetic fixture 对齐 PG microsecond，早期 safety 仍由实际服务计算。原与 mixed 两种 1000/200 workload 必须按真实 P95/hard/sweep、dataset 和分层资源分别计量；不声称 APPLY 吞吐。 Current execution review: the stated source requirement is bound below to original completed e278b1e execution and every selected method parameter instance; source-review statements awaiting execution describe that earlier review stage. Historical checkpoints and counts remain historical. The independently reviewed raw layers and explicit typed crosschecks supply the current measured boundary.
findings.proofLimits: Current admission is limited to each selected proof scope, including its explicit evidence boundary. Full source identity, successful parent and all selected parameter expansions were verified. Historical source-review limits are retained verbatim below; old commit/count or pending-execution wording denotes its original point in time, not a reassigned current result. Independent Controller approval, real Provider capability and all 24 production-blocking release obligations remain outside this engineering evidence. Historical source-review limits: 本版仅为当前候选源码与证明适用性复核。本版重审 POST-1381 的四处源差异，已精确绑定02e6172的Git/tree/完整inventory，完整当前执行待独立采纳；原1381失败历史不作新执行证明，proofSelections 为空；旧 7e 全量通过仅为 §6.24 修复前历史检查点，定向或失败运行不提供本版完整执行。独立 Controller、真实 Provider 和生产授权不由本评审提供。 Current e278b1e review: predecessor checkpoint/count statements above retain their historical scope. The new 1280-file source is independently Git-bound; no predecessor result is a current execution. Fresh complete parent and all named expansions remain required.
